title: 4chan whistleblower: nukes, jets and boats sent after the craft never came back

tellings.quote: He's like, "We've tried to um we've sent nukes after it like on submarines. We've sent jets. We've scrambled like boats. Like none of them come back.

plain: An anonymous whistleblower posting on 4chan, an anonymous online message board, claimed that the military has gone after an unknown craft in the ocean near the Bahamas with nuclear weapons fired from submarines, with jets and with boats, and that none of them came back. A YouTube creator named Chris Ramsay relays the post, quoting the poster: "We've sent nukes after it like on submarines. We've sent jets. We've scrambled like boats. Like none of them come back."
